entries.german: Verleiht Hans von Rosenberg den zehenden cleyne und grosse in dem dorne Lore zuschen Rotenburg an der Tuber und Insingen gelegen, der ledig worden ist.
entries.english: King Ruprecht grants to Hans von Rosenberg, Ritter the small and the great tithe in the village of Lohr, between Rothenburg an der Tauber and Insingen, which has become vacant. B.

facts.content: received the small and great tithes in Lohr as a fief from King Ruprecht.

entries.source: Regesta Boica 11 (Regesta sive rerum Boicarum autographa ad annum usque MCCC. 11 = Continuatio 7)
entries.german: Ruprecht römischer König belehnt Hans von Rosenberg Ritter, mit dem grossen und kleinen Zehenden in dem Dorfe Lor zwischen Rotenburg an der Tauber und Insingen. G. zu Botzen auf den Donnerstag nach sant Franciscen des heiligen Bichterstag.
entries.english: Ruprecht, King of the Romans, enfeoffs Hans von Rosenberg, Ritter, with the great and small tithes in the village of Lor between Rothenburg an der Tauber and Insingen. Given at Bolzano on the Thursday after the day of St. Francis the holy confessor.

facts.content: was enfeoffed by King Ruprecht with the great and small tithes in the village of Lor between Rothenburg an der Tauber and Insingen.
